# Structure-Function Coupling

```{r}
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(ggsegGlasser)
library(ggseg)
library(ggplot2)
library(afex)
library(emmeans)
library(tidytext)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
source("R/plotting.R")

setwd("../data_tidy/")

# CONFIGURATION
INPUT_FILE  <- "morphometrics.rds" 
ETIV_COL    <- "etiv" # eTIV column name
RESIDUALIZE_ETIV <- FALSE
RESIDUALIZE_MEASURES <- c("volume", "area")
OUTPUT_LONG <- "output_PC1_long.csv"
fixed_effects <- "group + age + sex + site"
# set globally to avoid repeated warnings
emm_options(lmerTest.limit = 30000, pbkrtest.limit = 30000)

dt <- as.data.table(readRDS(INPUT_FILE))
required_cols <- c("subject", "group", "measure", "morpho_score", "hemi", "region", "yeo", "stream", ETIV_COL)
missing <- setdiff(required_cols, names(dt))
if (length(missing) > 0) stop("Missing columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

cat(sprintf("Loaded %d rows, %d subjects, %d measures\n", nrow(dt), uniqueN(dt$subject), uniqueN(dt$measure)))
dt[, etiv_val := get(ETIV_COL)]

glasser_atlas <- ggsegGlasser::glasser()
```

# PCA of structural measures

## STEP 1: Residualize volume and area for eTIV

Model: morpho_score ~ etiv, per region × hemi × measure, across subjects

```{r}
dt[, residual_score := morpho_score]

if (RESIDUALIZE_ETIV) {
  cat("Step 1: Residualizing volume and area for eTIV...\n")
  for (meas in RESIDUALIZE_MEASURES) {
    cat(sprintf("  %s ~ etiv\n", meas))
    idx <- which(dt$measure == meas)
    sub <- dt[idx]
    sub[, residual_score := {
      if (.N < 5) {
        morpho_score
      } else {
        fit <- tryCatch(lm(morpho_score ~ etiv_val, data = .SD), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(fit)) morpho_score else residuals(fit)
      }
    }, by = .(region, hemi)]
    dt[idx, residual_score := sub$residual_score]
  }
  cat("  Done.\n")
}
```

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
thickness <- dt[measure == "thickness", ]

stats_lm <- thickness %>%
  group_by(region, hemi) %>%
  do({
    model <- lm(as.formula(paste("residual_score ~", fixed_effects)), data = .)
    
    # Extract group coefficient only
    tidy(model) %>%
      filter(grepl("^group", term))  # Keep only group effect
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(
    coefficient = estimate,
    statistic = statistic
  )

stats_combined <- stats_lm %>%
  mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  mutate(statistic_thresholded = ifelse(p_adjust < 0.05, statistic, 0))

stats_corr <- stats_combined %>%
  filter(p_adjust < 0.05)

stats_corr
```

## STEP 2: Z-score residuals across regions within each subject x measure

```{r}
dt[, region_hemi := paste0(hemi, "_", region)]
dt[, z_score := scale(residual_score)[, 1], by = .(subject, measure)]
dt[is.nan(z_score), z_score := 0]
```

## STEP 3: Within-subject PCA
<!-- Matrix layout: rows = measures (5), columns = regions (360) -->
<!-- pca$rotation[,1] -> PC1 loading per region (used downstream) -->
<!-- pca$x[,1]        -> PC1 score per measure (used for loading summary) -->

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
run_subject_pca <- function(sub_dt) {
  wide <- dcast(sub_dt, measure ~ region_hemi, value.var = "z_score")
  
  region_hemi_cols <- setdiff(names(wide), "measure")
  mat <- as.matrix(as.data.frame(wide)[, region_hemi_cols])
  rownames(mat) <- wide$measure
  
  keep <- colSums(is.na(mat)) == 0
  mat  <- mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  
  n_pcs <- min(3, nrow(mat), ncol(mat))
  
  if (ncol(mat) < 2 || nrow(mat) < 2) {
    empty_scores <- data.table(
      region_hemi   = region_hemi_cols,
      pc            = rep(1:3, each = length(region_hemi_cols)),
      pc_score      = NA_real_,
      var_explained = NA_real_
    )
    return(list(scores = empty_scores, mat = mat, loadings = NULL))  # >>> CHANGED
  }
  
  # >>> CHANGED: transpose + proper scaling
  pca <- prcomp(t(mat), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  
  var_exp  <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:n_pcs]
  loadings <- pca$rotation   # TRUE loadings
  scores   <- pca$x          # TRUE scores
  
  scores_list <- vector("list", n_pcs)
  for (pc in 1:n_pcs) {
    scores_list[[pc]] <- data.table(
      region_hemi   = rownames(scores),                 # >>> CHANGED
      pc            = pc,
      pc_score      = as.numeric(scores[, pc]),         # >>> CHANGED
      var_explained = var_exp[pc]
    )
  }
  
  list(
    scores   = rbindlist(scores_list),
    mat      = mat,
    loadings = loadings   # >>> NEW
  )
}

cat("Step 3: Running within-subject PCA...\n")
results_list <- dt[, list(res = list(run_subject_pca(.SD))), by = subject]

pc1_scores <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(results_list)), function(i) {
  d <- results_list$res[[i]]$scores
  d[, subject := results_list$subject[i]]
  d
}))

pc1_scores[, hemi   := sub("_.*", "", region_hemi)]
pc1_scores[, region := sub("^[^_]*_", "", region_hemi)]
cat(sprintf("  PCA complete for %d subjects.\n", uniqueN(pc1_scores$subject)))

var_summary <- pc1_scores[, .(
  var_explained = round(mean(var_explained, na.rm = TRUE)*100, digits = 1),
  sd            = round(sd(var_explained,   na.rm = TRUE)*100, digits = 1)
), by = pc]
cat("\nMean variance explained per PC:\n")
print(var_summary)

# Step 4: Sign alignment
cat("Step 4: Aligning PC sign across subjects...\n")
ref_profile <- dt[, .(mean_z = mean(z_score, na.rm = TRUE)), by = region_hemi]

sign_check <- pc1_scores[!is.na(pc_score)][
  ref_profile, on = "region_hemi", nomatch = 0
][, .(r = cor(pc_score, mean_z, use = "complete.obs")), by = .(subject, pc)]

sign_check[, {
  n_neg <- sum(r < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_pos <- sum(r >= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("  PC%d — Subjects with positive alignment: %d, negative: %d\n", pc[1], n_pos, n_neg))
}, by = pc]

pc1_scores <- merge(pc1_scores, sign_check, by = c("subject", "pc"))
pc1_scores[r < 0, pc_score := -pc_score]
pc1_scores[, r := NULL]

# Step 5: Extract TRUE loadings and align sign
cat("Step 5: Extracting and aligning true PCA loadings...\n")

pc1_loadings <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(results_list)), function(i) {
  sub <- results_list$subject[i]
  res <- results_list$res[[i]]
  mat <- res$mat
  
  if (is.null(mat) || is.null(res$loadings)) return(NULL)
  
  loadings <- res$loadings
  
  n_pcs <- min(3, ncol(loadings))
  
  rbindlist(lapply(1:n_pcs, function(pc_i) {
    
    pca <- prcomp(t(mat), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
    raw_scores <- pca$x[, pc_i]
    
    aligned_scores <- pc1_scores[
      subject == sub & pc == pc_i,
      .(region_hemi, pc_score)
    ]
    
    aligned_scores <- aligned_scores[region_hemi %in% rownames(pca$x)]
    aligned_vec <- aligned_scores$pc_score[
      match(rownames(pca$x), aligned_scores$region_hemi)
    ]
    
    if (any(is.na(aligned_vec))) return(NULL)
    
    # >>> NEW: compute sign flip
    sign_flip <- sign(cor(raw_scores, aligned_vec))
    
    # >>> NEW: apply to TRUE loadings
    aligned_loadings <- loadings[, pc_i] * sign_flip
    
    data.table(
      subject    = sub,
      measure    = rownames(loadings),
      pc         = pc_i,
      pc_loading = aligned_loadings
    )
  }))
}))

# Step 6: Summarise loadings
cat("Step 6: Summarising per-measure PC loadings...\n")
loading_summary <- pc1_loadings[, .(
  mean_loading = round(mean(pc_loading, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
  sd_loading   = round(sd(pc_loading,   na.rm = TRUE), 3)
), by = .(pc, measure)] %>%
  arrange(pc, mean_loading)

cat("\nPer-measure PC loadings (mean ± SD across subjects):\n")
print(loading_summary)
```

## STEP 6: Merge PC1 scores back into main data table and save

```{r}
dt[, etiv_val := NULL]

# Reshape scores from long to wide (one column per PC)
pc_scores_wide <- dcast(pc1_scores, subject + hemi + region ~ pc, 
                        value.var = "pc_score")
setnames(pc_scores_wide, 
         old = c("1", "2", "3"), 
         new = c("pc1_score", "pc2_score", "pc3_score"))

# Also add var_explained per PC as separate columns
var_wide <- dcast(unique(pc1_scores[, .(subject, pc, var_explained)]),
                  subject ~ pc, value.var = "var_explained")
setnames(var_wide,
         old = c("1", "2", "3"),
         new = c("pc1_var_explained", "pc2_var_explained", "pc3_var_explained"))

dt_out <- merge(dt, pc_scores_wide, by = c("subject", "hemi", "region"), all.x = TRUE)
dt_out <- merge(dt_out, var_wide,   by = "subject", all.x = TRUE)

fwrite(dt_out, OUTPUT_LONG)
cat(sprintf("  Saved: %s  (%d rows)\n", OUTPUT_LONG, nrow(dt_out)))
```

# PCA - group comparisons, ROI approach

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
dt_pc <- unique(dt_out[, .(subject, group, age, sex, site, region, hemi, yeo, pc1_score, pc2_score, pc3_score)])

stats_lm <- dt_pc %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pc1_score, pc2_score, pc3_score),
               names_to = "pc",
               values_to = "pc_score") %>%
  mutate(pc = as.integer(gsub("pc(\\d)_score", "\\1", pc))) %>%
  group_by(region, hemi, yeo, pc) %>%
  do({
    model <- lm(as.formula(paste("pc_score ~", fixed_effects)), data = .)
    tidy(model) %>%
      filter(grepl("^group", term))
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(
    coefficient = estimate,
    statistic   = statistic
  )

stats_combined <- stats_lm %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(pc) %>%                                      # FDR correction within each PC
  mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(statistic_thresholded = ifelse(p_adjust < 0.05, statistic, 0))

stats_corr <- stats_combined %>%
  filter(p_adjust < 0.05)

print(stats_corr)
```

```{r}
dt_pc[, region_plot := region]
dt_pc[region_plot == "7Pl", region_plot := "7PL"]

plot_pc_brain <- function(data, pc_num = 1, groups = c("CB", "SC"), atlas = glasser_atlas) {
  
  pc_col <- paste0("pc", pc_num, "_score")
  
  pca_df <- data[group %in% groups,
                 .(mean_pc_score = mean(get(pc_col), na.rm = TRUE)),
                 by = .(region, hemi, group)]
  
  atlas_skel <- atlas$core %>%
  left_join(
    atlas$data$sf %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      select(label, side = view) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "label"
  ) %>%
  select(hemi, side, region, label)
  
  full_data <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
    df_group <- pca_df[group == g, .(hemi, region, mean_pc_score)]
    
    atlas_skel %>%
      left_join(df_group, by = c("hemi", "region")) %>%
      mutate(group = g)
  })
  
  full_data <- bind_rows(full_data)
  full_data$group <- factor(full_data$group, levels = groups)
  
  mid_val <- mean(range(full_data$mean_pc_score, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  atlas$data$sf <- atlas$data$sf %>%
    filter(view %in% c("lateral", "medial"))
  
  ggplot(full_data) +
    geom_brain(atlas    = atlas,
               position = position_brain(view ~ hemi),
               aes(fill = mean_pc_score)) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#00AFBB",
      mid = "#E7B800",
      high = "#FC4E07",
      midpoint = mid_val,
      na.value = "grey80"
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.title.align = 0.5,
      text = element_text(size = 8),
      strip.text        = element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
    labs(fill = paste0("PC\nscore"),
         title = paste0("PC", pc_num))
}

sc_pc <- dt_pc[group == "SC", ]
pc1_plot <- plot_pc_brain(sc_pc, pc_num = 1)
pc2_plot <- plot_pc_brain(sc_pc, pc_num = 2)
pc3_plot <- plot_pc_brain(sc_pc, pc_num = 3)
```

# SFC - group comparisons, ROI approach

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
func <- readRDS("../data_tidy/gradients.RDS")
func_struct <- left_join(func, dt_pc)
func_struct[, group := relevel(group, ref = "SC")]
func_struct[, age_c := scale(age, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)]

pcs       <- c("pc1_score", "pc2_score", "pc3_score")
gradients <- c("gradient_1", "gradient_2", "gradient_3")
combos    <- CJ(pc = pcs, gradient = gradients)

group_colors <- c(CB = "#43BF71", SC = "#440154")

pc_labels <- c(
  "pc1_score" = "PC1\n",
  "pc2_score" = "PC2\n",
  "pc3_score" = "PC3\n"
)

gradient_labels <- c(
  gradient_1 = "Gradient 1",
  gradient_2 = "Gradient 2",
  gradient_3 = "Gradient 3"
)

run_afex_model <- function(data, pc_col, gradient_name) {
  
  data_gradient <- data[gradient == gradient_name]
  data_gradient[["pc_score"]] <- data_gradient[[pc_col]]
  
  # fit with afex - tries random slope first
  fit <- tryCatch(
    mixed(gradient_score ~ pc_score * group + age_c + sex + site +
            (1 + pc_score | subject),
          data    = data_gradient,
          method  = "S",
          control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
          check_contrasts = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  random_structure <- "random_slope"
  if (is.null(fit) || isSingular(fit$full_model)) {
    fit <- tryCatch(
      mixed(gradient_score ~ pc_score * group + age_c + sex + site +
              (1 | subject),
            data    = data_gradient,
            method  = "S",
            control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
            check_contrasts = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    random_structure <- "intercept_only"
  }
  
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  
  saveRDS(fit, file = paste0("../results/fit_", pc_col, "_", gradient_name, ".RDS"))
  
  # anova table - reference level independent
  anova_table <- as.data.table(anova(fit), keep.rownames = "term")
  anova_table[, `:=`(pc = pc_col, gradient = gradient_name,
                     random_structure = random_structure)]
  
  # emtrends - simple slopes per group
  emtrends_res <- emtrends(fit$full_model, ~ group, var = "pc_score")
  
  emtrends_dt  <- as.data.table(summary(emtrends_res))
  emtrends_dt[, `:=`(pc = pc_col,
                     gradient = gradient_name,
                     random_structure = random_structure)]
  
  # test slopes against zero
  slopes_test  <- as.data.table(test(emtrends_res))
  slopes_test[, `:=`(pc = pc_col, gradient = gradient_name)]
  
  list(
    anova   = anova_table,
    trends  = emtrends_dt,
    trends_obj = emtrends_res,
    tests   = slopes_test,
    fit = fit$full_model
  )
}

# run for all combinations
results_afex <- mapply(
  function(pc, grad) run_afex_model(func_struct, pc, grad),
  combos$pc, combos$gradient,
  SIMPLIFY = FALSE
)

# collate results
anova_results  <- rbindlist(lapply(results_afex, `[[`, "anova"))
trends_results <- rbindlist(lapply(results_afex, `[[`, "trends"))
tests_results_roi  <- rbindlist(lapply(results_afex, `[[`, "tests"))

# FDR correction
# ANOVA: FDR across all 9 models, separately per term
anova_results[, p_fdr := p.adjust(`Pr(>F)`, method = "fdr"), by = .(term)]
anova_results[,  significant := p_fdr < 0.05]

results_roi <- anova_results[term == "pc_score" | term == "pc_score:group", ]
results_roi[, p_fdr_fmt := ifelse(
  p_fdr < 0.001,
  "< .001",
  formatC(p_fdr, format = "f", digits = 3)
)]
results_roi
```

```{r}
# if pc/gradient not stored in res, parse from key
pc_cols       <- c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")
gradient_cols <- c("G1",  "G2",  "G3")

subject_slopes_list        <- list()
group_slopes_ci_list       <- list()
group_slopes_ci_pooled_list <- list()
pred_data_list             <- list()
pred_data_pooled_list      <- list()

for (i in seq_along(results_afex)) {
  res      <- results_afex[[i]]
  full_fit <- res$fit
  if (is.null(full_fit)) next

  pc_col        <- combos$pc[i]
  gradient_name <- combos$gradient[i]
  key           <- paste(pc_col, gradient_name, sep = "_")

  mf       <- model.frame(full_fit)
  sex_ref  <- levels(mf$sex)[1]
  site_ref <- levels(mf$site)[1]
  random_structure <- unique(res$trends$random_structure)

  # ── Subject slopes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fe      <- fixef(full_fit)
  fe_slope <- fe["pc_score"]
  fe_int   <- fe["(Intercept)"]

  group_levels    <- levels(mf$group)
  group_slope_adj <- sapply(group_levels, function(g) {
    term <- paste0("pc_score:group", g)
    if (term %in% names(fe)) fe[term] else 0
  })
  names(group_slope_adj) <- group_levels

  re         <- as.data.table(ranef(full_fit)$subject, keep.rownames = "subject")
  subj_group <- unique(mf[, c("subject", "group")])
  re         <- merge(re, subj_group, by = "subject")

  if (random_structure == "random_slope") {
    re[, slope     := fe_slope + unname(group_slope_adj[as.character(group)]) + get("pc_score")]
    re[, intercept := fe_int + `(Intercept)`]
  } else {
    re[, slope     := fe_slope + unname(group_slope_adj[as.character(group)])]
    re[, intercept := fe_int + `(Intercept)`]
  }
  re[, `:=`(pc = pc_col, gradient = gradient_name, random_structure = random_structure)]
  subject_slopes_list[[key]] <- re[, .(subject, group, slope, intercept, pc, gradient, random_structure)]

  # ── Group slope CIs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  et    <- emtrends(full_fit, ~ group, var = "pc_score")
  et_dt <- as.data.table(summary(et, infer = TRUE))
  setnames(et_dt,
           old = c("pc_score.trend", "lower.CL", "upper.CL"),
           new = c("slope", "slope_lower", "slope_upper"))
  et_dt[, `:=`(pc = pc_col, gradient = gradient_name, random_structure = random_structure)]
  group_slopes_ci_list[[key]] <- et_dt[, .(group, slope, slope_lower, slope_upper, pc, gradient, random_structure)]

  # ── Pooled slope CI ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  et_pooled    <- emmeans(et, ~ 1)
  et_pooled_dt <- as.data.table(summary(et_pooled, infer = TRUE))
  setnames(et_pooled_dt,
           old = c("pc_score.trend", "lower.CL", "upper.CL"),
           new = c("slope", "slope_lower", "slope_upper"))
  et_pooled_dt[, `:=`(group = "pooled", pc = pc_col, gradient = gradient_name, random_structure = random_structure)]
  group_slopes_ci_pooled_list[[key]] <- et_pooled_dt[, .(group, slope, slope_lower, slope_upper, pc, gradient, random_structure)]

  # ── Group-level predictions ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  pc_range <- seq(min(mf$pc_score, na.rm = TRUE), max(mf$pc_score, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)

  em    <- emmeans(full_fit, ~ pc_score * group,
                   at = list(pc_score = pc_range, age_c = 0, sex = sex_ref, site = site_ref))
  pred  <- as.data.table(summary(em, infer = TRUE))
  pred[, `:=`(pc = pc_col, gradient = gradient_name)]
  setnames(pred, "emmean", "fitted")
  if ("asymp.LCL" %in% names(pred)) setnames(pred, c("asymp.LCL", "asymp.UCL"), c("lower.CL", "upper.CL"))
  pred_data_list[[key]] <- pred[, .(pc_score, group, fitted, lower.CL, upper.CL, pc, gradient)]

  # ── Pooled predictions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  em_pooled    <- emmeans(em, ~ pc_score)
  pred_pooled  <- as.data.table(summary(em_pooled, infer = TRUE))
  pred_pooled[, `:=`(pc = pc_col, gradient = gradient_name, group = "pooled")]
  setnames(pred_pooled, "emmean", "fitted")
  if ("asymp.LCL" %in% names(pred_pooled)) setnames(pred_pooled, c("asymp.LCL", "asymp.UCL"), c("lower.CL", "upper.CL"))
  pred_data_pooled_list[[key]] <- pred_pooled[, .(pc_score, group, fitted, lower.CL, upper.CL, pc, gradient)]
}

subject_slopes         <- rbindlist(subject_slopes_list)
group_slopes_ci        <- rbindlist(group_slopes_ci_list)
group_slopes_ci_pooled <- rbindlist(group_slopes_ci_pooled_list)
pred_data              <- rbindlist(pred_data_list)
pred_data_pooled       <- rbindlist(pred_data_pooled_list)
class(pred_data_pooled) <- "data.frame"
```

## Figure 5C

```{r}
# ── 0.  Define your combos (pc × gradient) ────────────────────────────────────
pc_list       <- unique(combos$pc)
gradient_list <- unique(combos$gradient)

# ── 0b. Define slope panel annotations ────────────────────────────────────────
annot_left <- data.frame(
  pc       = c("pc1_score", "pc2_score", "pc3_score"),
  gradient = c("gradient_1", "gradient_1", "gradient_1"),
  x        = c(-Inf, -Inf, -Inf),
  y        = c(Inf, Inf, Inf),
  label    = c(
    "low volume\nsmall area\nconcave\nsulci",
    "small area\nthick",
    "thin"
  )
)

annot_right <- data.frame(
  pc       = c("pc1_score", "pc2_score", "pc3_score"),
  gradient = c("gradient_1", "gradient_1", "gradient_1"),
  x        = c(Inf, Inf, Inf),
  y        = c(Inf, Inf, Inf),
  label    = c(
    "high volume\nlarge area\nconvex\ngyri",
    "large area\nthin",
    "thick"
  )
)

annot_gradient <- data.frame(
  pc       = c("pc1_score", "pc1_score", "pc1_score", "pc1_score", "pc1_score", "pc1_score"),
  gradient = c("gradient_1", "gradient_1", "gradient_2", "gradient_2", "gradient_3", "gradient_3"),
  x        = c(-Inf, -Inf, -Inf, -Inf, -Inf, -Inf),
  y        = c(-Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf),
  label    = c("unimodal", "transmodal", "visual", "sensorimotor", "frontoparietal", "rest")
)

# calculate y-limits for plotting with same y-axis
y_limits <- lapply(setNames(gradient_list, gradient_list), function(g) {
  pd_g <- pred_data[pred_data$gradient == g, ]
  c(min(pd_g$lower.CL, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(pd_g$upper.CL, na.rm = TRUE))
})

y_limits_dot <- c(
  min(group_slopes_ci$slope_lower, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(group_slopes_ci$slope_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
)

sig_int  <- results_roi[term == "pc_score:group", .(pc, gradient, sig_interaction = significant)]
sig_main <- results_roi[term == "pc_score",       .(pc, gradient, sig_main = significant)]

slope_state <- merge(sig_int, sig_main, by = c("pc", "gradient"))
slope_state[, plot_mode := fcase(
  sig_interaction == TRUE, "by_group",
  sig_main == TRUE,        "pooled",
  default =                "flat"
)]

mode_lookup <- setNames(slope_state$plot_mode, paste0(slope_state$pc, "_", slope_state$gradient))

# ── 3.  Build panel grid ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
panel_list <- list()
for (gi in seq_along(gradient_list)) {
  grad          <- gradient_list[gi]
  is_top_row    <- gi == 1
  for (pi in seq_along(pc_list)) {
    pc_col        <- pc_list[pi]
    is_left_col   <- pi == 1
    is_bottom_row <- gi == length(gradient_list)
    is_last_pc    <- pi == length(pc_list)
    
    panel_list[[length(panel_list) + 1]] <- make_slope_panel(
      pc_col, grad,
      show_y_axis    = TRUE,
      show_x_axis    = is_bottom_row,
      show_strip_top = is_top_row,
      y_limits       = y_limits[[grad]],
      plot_mode      = mode_lookup[paste0(pc_col, "_", grad)]
    )

    panel_list[[length(panel_list) + 1]] <- make_dot_panel(
      pc_col, grad,
      show_strip_top     = is_top_row,
      large_right_margin = FALSE,
      y_limits           = y_limits_dot,
      plot_mode          = mode_lookup[paste0(pc_col, "_", grad)]
    )
  }
}

# ── 4.  Assemble ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
col_widths <- rep(c(3, 1), length(pc_list))
n_rows     <- length(gradient_list)
n_cols     <- length(pc_list) * 2

final_plot <- Reduce(`+`, panel_list) +
  plot_layout(
    nrow   = n_rows,
    ncol   = n_cols,
    widths = col_widths,
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

final_plot
```
